findings.title: Handle index retrieval rejection before awaiting remote calls
findings.defect: curated retriever rejecting while the Graphiti search is pending left indexedWork without a rejection handler until both remote operations finished; a corrupt review/index JSON or filesystem read failure caused an unhandled rejection terminating the strict-Node host process
findings.source_correction: docs/issue-75/v2-candidate/memory-core.mjs: indexedWork attaches fulfillment AND rejection handlers at creation (.then(rows => ..., () => [])), degrading to [] on any failure; the deferred await cannot observe an unhandled rejection

regression_proof.test: early curated retriever rejection is safely handled during a slower Graphiti search
regression_proof.scenario: retriever rejects while a 65 ms mocked Graphiti search is pending; strict unhandled-rejection policy would fail the process before search settles if the handler were deferred

findings.title: Keep optional remote proof from blocking legacy recall
findings.defect: every successful fact search waited for get_episodes (1200 ms transport timeout) before resolving even already-sourced legacy facts, including with an empty local inventory; a slow optional read can exceed the native 300 ms hook allowance and suppress legacy recall
findings.source_correction: docs/issue-75/v2-candidate/memory-core.mjs: legacy sourced candidates materialize first; optional enrichment bounded to a COMBINED 70 ms window (INDEX_ENRICHMENT_MAX_WAIT_MS) starting after the legacy path is ready via optionalWithin(); get_episodes fires only when a pre-proof shortlist has qualifying index candidates AND budget remains; its rejection handler is attached immediately; a slow initial Graphiti query does not ban a fast positive indexed proof

tests.test: slow optional proof cannot delay an otherwise sourced legacy result
tests.scenario: sourced legacy fact + 410 ms optional proof rejection: same source result returns in <270 ms and no unproven index record injects

tests.test: optional remote proof is skipped when curated source inventory has no qualifying facts
tests.scenario: empty curated inventory: NO get_episodes RPC at all; valid legacy result preserved (call log asserts [search_memory_facts] only)

tests.test: a slow initial Graphiti search does not discard fast positive indexed proof
tests.scenario: 285 ms cold search (>245 ms) followed by fast positive episode proof: index fact still recovers; optional budget measured after legacy source resolution

tests.test: source-correct fact at Graphiti result position 19 survives the 24-candidate bound when index route is also enabled
tests.scenario: updated to assert get_episodes is NOT called when the positive curation inventory is empty

findings.title: Qualify reranked candidates before truncating the merged list
findings.defect: with a reranker configured, the alternating merge discarded unsorted Graphiti positions 13-24 whenever >=12 curated candidates qualified, before relevance scoring; a semantically correct fact at remote position 19 disappeared from ranker input and was replaced by a weaker indexed observation
findings.source_correction: docs/issue-75/v2-candidate/relevance.mjs + memory-core.mjs: new rankQualifiedForMerge() scores ALL 24 Graphiti candidates ONCE before the 24-slot shared merge; per-candidate scores (scoreByItem) and comparison background are bound to candidate objects and reused by the final one-fact selector via cachedScores/cachedBackground — no second reranker HTTP call; without a reranker the existing bounded lexical path is unchanged

tests.test: reranker scores all 24 Graphiti facts before merging 12 indexed facts, only once
tests.scenario: 24 Graphiti facts (correct fact at index 19) + 12 qualified curated rows: ranker input length asserted 24, correct fact selected, ranker call counter asserted == 1

tests.test: independent reranker retains bounded semantic-choice admission when no index is installed
tests.scenario: reranker semantic-choice admission path preserved without an index
